name: Agrobank FRESH
tagline: Mobile banking app prototype for Agrobank: cards, Click payments, transfers and deposits
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team for Agrobank

scenes.title: Phone sign-in, SMS code and PIN
scenes.body: Masked phone login, a 5-digit SMS code with a countdown, and a 4-digit PIN each time the app opens.

scenes.title: Balances and payment history
scenes.body: Uzcard balances with one-tap refresh, a pull-up sheet of recent payments, and the virtual Visa under Currency.

scenes.title: Bill payments via the Click API
scenes.body: Categories, providers and each payment form are built at runtime from Click's JSON-RPC responses.

scenes.title: Transfers, virtual Visa and deposits
scenes.body: Card-to-card transfers show the bank fee before sending; open a virtual Visa or an online deposit from a card.

scenes.title: Branch map and ATMs by region
scenes.body: Branches pinned on a map around your location, and ATM addresses listed region by region.
